content: drei Environment without HDRI: pass children instead of preset. E.g. <Environment><Lightformer intensity={2} position={[0,1,0]} scale={[10,10,1]} /></Environment>. Or use background=false (default) with colored ambient/point/directional lights directly in the scene — no Environment needed at all for token-driven lighting. The preset strings (apartment, city, dawn, etc.) load remote HDRI files from github — NOT suitable for production (external network request). For glass/transmission materials, the scene environment affects refraction environment map. Using colored lights + no Environment is the lightest approach for LCP budget. Environment with custom children renders an off-buffer cube camera once — lighter than a loaded HDRI but still has a render cost. Recommendation: use directional/point/ambient lights with token hex values as named JS constants, skip Environment entirely for this simple scene.
